mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: High and rising unemployment (UNRATE > 9.5 and UNRATE change > 0.3pp over 3 months) signals economic distress and reduced corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 9.5 and UNRATE change > 0.3pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the periods when UNRATE > 9.5 and UNRATE change > 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand and impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 95) signals a supply shock and economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during a recessionary regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the periods when INDPRO < 95 and GDPC1 growth is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 600 thousand units signals robust consumer confidence and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the periods when HOUST > 600.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 95) signals an imminent economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days in a supply shock regime.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the periods when INDPRO < 95.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of declining federal funds rate and low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.0%) signals an accommodative monetary policy environment that supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the periods when FEDFUNDS is declining and CPIAUCSL < 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained slowdown in employment growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.1% over 3 months) indicates economic weakness and reduced corporate earnings potential, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the periods when PAYEMS growth < 0.1% in 3 months.
